headline: Congress named a federal building and courthouse in Dayton, Ohio, after former federal judge Walter H. Rice.
what_it_does: This law renames the federal building and U.S. courthouse at 200 West 2nd Street in Dayton, Ohio, as the Walter H. Rice Federal Building and United States Courthouse. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change any court rules, jobs, or services.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 13, 2018, and the new name took effect on that date.
